title: Contracts Paralegal
description:
Contracts Paralegal - 6 Month FTC

Location: London

Contract: 6 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Sector: Legal / Law Firm

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

The Opportunity

We are working with a leading international law firm that is seeking a Contracts Paralegal to join their in-house legal function on a 6-month fixed-term contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for a legally trained professional looking to gain valuable in-house experience within a leading law firm, with exposure to commercial contracts, legal procurement, supplier management and contract lifecycle management.

The successful candidate will work closely with the firm's Legal team and a variety of Business Professional functions, supporting the management of the firm's third-party supplier relationships and ensuring contracts are effectively managed throughout their lifecycle.

This is a varied and stakeholder-focused role, suited to a proactive and highly organised Paralegal who is comfortable managing multiple matters and working with senior stakeholders across the

business.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the firm's in-house Legal team with the management and administration of commercial and supplier contracts.
- Assist with the onboarding of new third-party suppliers, including reviewing supplier questionnaires and supporting documentation.
- Work closely with Information Security and Data Privacy teams to ensure prospective suppliers meet the firm's data protection, information security and regulatory requirements.
- Liaise with the Legal team, Business Professional teams and other internal stakeholders to understand requirements and timelines relating to the implementation, renewal, extension and termination of supplier contracts.
- Provide practical support and guidance to stakeholders throughout the firm's legal procurement process.
- Maintain accurate supplier and contract records within the firm's HighQ contract management system.
- Upload and maintain UK supplier records, contracts and associated documentation.
- Manage the legal procurement matter intake mailbox and maintain the active matter tracker.
- Coordinate with relevant Business Professional teams to ensure contract-related actions and deliverables are completed within agreed timescales.
- Monitor key contractual dates, including expiry, renewal, extension and notice periods, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are alerted.
- Support the ongoing maintenance and development of the firm's contract lifecycle management processes.
- Work with Business Professional teams to identify and capture existing UK supplier contracts within the contract management system.
- Assist with updating supplier questionnaires, templates and other documentation used throughout the legal procurement process.
- Support training and guidance for Business Professional teams on the firm's legal procurement processes and contract management system.
- Assist with wider projects and initiatives undertaken by the Legal team.

About You

We are looking for a highly organised and commercially minded Contracts Paralegal who is keen to develop their experience within an in-house legal environment.

You will have excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to manage a varied workload while working to competing deadlines. You should be confident liaising with stakeholders across the firm, including senior management and Business Professional teams.

The ideal candidate will have:
- A UK law degree or Commonwealth equivalent.
- Previous experience as a Paralegal, ideally with exposure to commercial contracts, supplier agreements or procurement.
- A good understanding of commercial law and contracts.
- An interest in working in an in-house legal function within a law firm.
- Excellent research and analytical skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities.
- Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- The ability to quickly learn and navigate bespoke legal and document management systems.
- Experience with HighQ and/or iManage would be advantageous.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity for a Contracts Paralegal to gain valuable experience within a leading law firm.

The role offers exposure to a broad range of commercial and operational matters, including supplier contracts, legal procurement, contract lifecycle management, data privacy and information security.

You will work alongside experienced legal and business professionals and gain insight into how a sophisticated international law firm manages its own commercial relationships and supplier portfolio.

The 6-month FTC is an ideal opportunity for a Paralegal looking to make the move into an in-house environment or build on existing commercial contracts experience.

Apply Now

If you are a legally trained Paralegal with an interest in commercial contracts and are looking for an opportunity to develop your in-house experience within a leading law firm, we would be keen to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Natalie Dwan at LJ Recruitment for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

title: IP Litigation Paralegal
company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
About the role

We are recruiting on behalf of a specialist City law firm with an active contentious practice. They need an experienced litigation paralegal to work alongside their disputes lawyers on cases covering the full IP spectrum: patents, trade marks, copyright, designs (registered and unregistered), passing off, confidential information and trade secrets, as well as technology-led commercial claims.

It's a hands-on position with real responsibility from day one. You'll be involved at every stage of a case, from pre-action through to trial, and will deal directly with clients, counsel and the court. Well suited to a paralegal who sees their future in contentious IP.

Day to day

Casework and drafting
- Helping the team run live disputes, working with fee-earners at all levels.
- Producing first drafts of applications, witness statements, letters, consent orders and general procedural paperwork, ready for a lawyer to approve.
- Preparing chronologies, summaries of key documents, case management reports, costs budgets and statements of costs.
- Carrying out legal and factual research, and helping gather evidence and take witness accounts.

Court and counsel
- Issuing and lodging documents electronically (CE-File and similar) and keeping on top of correspondence from the court.
- Acting as the day-to-day contact for court staff, judges' clerks, tribunals and outside service providers.
- Working with chambers to fix hearings, conferences and mediations, and drafting instructions to counsel.
- Getting cases trial-ready, going to court with the team where needed and drafting orders afterwards.

Disclosure, bundles and case management
- Running disclosure and e-disclosure, from document review through to production.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality Right to Manage (RTM) services to leaseholder clients, using a meticulous approach to detail and a calm, organised style to run your own caseload end-to-end. From early-stage eligibility checks to acquisition, you will keep every matter moving, anticipating risks, meeting deadlines, and communicating clearly with all parties.

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

Most days, you will progress a portfolio of RTM matters, preparing and serving notices, drafting documents, managing timelines, and liaising with clients, freeholders, and agents. You will keep immaculate records in our case management system, provide timely updates, and collaborate with colleagues in property management and tech to refine processes and solve problems.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- You move RTM cases from instruction to acquisition smoothly, on time, and with minimal escalations.
- Your files are accurate, audit-ready, and demonstrate consistent application of RTM procedures and statutory timelines.
- Clients feel informed and supported, with proactive updates and clear, jargon-free advice.
- You spot risks early, propose practical solutions, and escalate only when needed.
- You use technology to increase speed and quality, contributing ideas that improve templates and workflows.
- You build trusted relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders, helping resolve issues collaboratively.

HOW YOU'LL SPEND MOST OF YOUR TIME
- Conducting RTM eligibility checks, title reviews, and due diligence on buildings, leases, and tenant participation.
- Preparing, serving, and tracking statutory notices, including Notices of Invitation to Participate and Notices of Claim.
- Managing critical dates, responses, and counter-notices, and coordinating the acquisition process.
- Drafting correspondence and standard documents, and maintaining accurate file notes and document bundles.
- Liaising with leaseholders, RTM company directors, landlords, managing agents, and external advisors.
- Updating the case management system, generating reports, and refining templates and processes with our tech tools.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR
- You are detail-obsessed, organised, and comfortable running your own caseload with appropriate oversight.
- You communicate clearly and empathetically, tailoring explanations to non-legal audiences.
- You stay calm under pressure, prioritise effectively, and keep multiple matters moving at pace.
- You are tech-curious, keen to use and improve digital tools that enhance quality and efficiency.
- You take ownership, seek feedback, and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver great outcomes.

EXPERIENCE THAT HELPS
- Exposure to leasehold law, RTM processes, or property litigation in a law firm, in-house team, or specialist service provider.
- Hands-on experience with case management systems, document automation, or data-driven dashboards.
- Drafting and serving statutory notices, and managing matter timelines and critical dates.
- Client-facing experience, balancing empathy with commercial pragmatism in written and verbal communications.
- Coordinating multi-stakeholder matters and preparing orderly, audit-ready legal files.

WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive salary
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Salary sacrifice scheme and the option to buy annual leave
- Spectrum Life wellbeing platform
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Fully funded training and professional development
- Employee referral scheme, up to £1,500

ABOUT ODEVO UK

We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.

Residential real estate is the world's largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.

In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 12,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.

By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.

Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.

As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.

If you share our mindset and ambition, we'd love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

HOW WE HIRE
- Initial conversation with our talent team
- Interview focused on assessing your RTM knowledge, case management discipline, stakeholder communication, and comfort using technology to improve delivery

We aim to complete the process within two to three weeks and communicate clearly throughout.

INTERESTED?

Apply with your CV.
